test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

Thorium has

P. and is part of a nuclear programme in India

Q. of nuclear reactor in countries including

R. been tested as a fuel in other types

S. the United States, Germany and the United Kingdom,
solution:
The correct answer is **"RQSP".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first sentence will be **R** which will be **"been tested as a fuel in other types".**
 
• **"of nuclear reactor in countries including"** will be the **second one** which is **Q**.
 
• The third order will be **"the United States, Germany and the United Kingdom,".**
 
• And the last one is **"and is part of a nuclear programme in India".**

Therefore the correct order is **option 1).**
